name: ZCA_USER_FAVORITES
description: This table stores the list of favorites for users. A favorite can belong to any object eg: an object record.

columns.name: USER_FAVORITE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a user favorite.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: Stores the user's Global Unique Id.The users defined in per_users.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: FK To HZ_PARTIES.  Identifier of the user.

columns.name: FAVORITE_TYPE
columns.description: Types of favorites like OBJECT, etc.

columns.name: FAVORITE_OBJECT
columns.description: Rest Resource Name of the object.

columns.name: FAVORITE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: A key that uniquely identifies the object that is set in favorite_object column.

columns.name: FAVORITE_HINT
columns.description: Identifies the entity as belonging to the object that is set in favorite_object column.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_ACCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the last accessed date and time of the favorite object row.
